requested_architect_status: Unavailable: T3 and local CLI reported unauthenticated after user login; Cursor fallback provider disabled. No Opus review occurred.
actual_review_model: Codex GPT-6.1-Sol, independent T3 child tasks

corrections.finding: Package packets credited support removed by another cut.
corrections.resolution: All packet suitability/interruption views use complete prospective package; original cut loss sources stay separate.

corrections.finding: Memory deduplicated physical copies and omitted mechanical fields.
corrections.resolution: Multiset deck identity plus mechanic-bearing fields, separate canonical catalog/enriched lineage captured and recalled by one read-only function.

corrections.finding: Supporting catalog changes did not invalidate memory; snapshots could mask catalog drift; saved entries lacked catalog fields.
corrections.resolution: All catalog dependencies are captured using the same projection as recall; catalog and enriched snapshot fingerprints remain independent. Unknown/missing sources abstain.

corrections.finding: Cache A/B/A returned A but reviewed B.
corrections.resolution: Cache hits restore deep-copied active review evidence.

corrections.finding: Episode verdicts discarded the judged claim.
corrections.resolution: Retain bounded claim text, card bindings, category, corrections and evidence identities; deduplicate investigation content.

corrections.finding: Graph display truncation changed cut scores under entry permutation.
corrections.resolution: Complete incident retention counts precede deterministic display truncation; legacy incomplete graphs use a conservative fallback.

corrections.finding: Nominal retrieval aspects duplicated the same serialized evidence.
corrections.resolution: Shared bounded strategy pool selects aspect-relevant passages, reports uncovered aspects, and serializes references once. Requested limit is passed through.

corrections.finding: Semantic views enriched only an existing shortlist.
corrections.resolution: Validated view nominations enter both functional and general eligible pools before final shortlist bounds.

corrections.finding: View identity omitted completeness/layout; batch nomination could drop viable matches.
corrections.resolution: Mechanical/completeness/layout facts bind view hashes; incomplete/unsupported projections abstain; all batch matches reach the union.

limits: Reviews and synthetic regressions are not independent MTG expert qualification.
Last two memory findings were corrected with regression tests after round 3; do not describe the review as an Opus approval.
Corpus adds 48 original AI-authored passages and 3 attributed short AI synopses, not permissioned external primer reproductions or externally reviewed recommendations.
Optional view vectors require explicit offline preparation; missing/stale indexes retain lexical fallback.
Local 100-card CPU benchmark is not end-to-end latency or broad recommendation quality.
No model weights were trained; no new paid service or dependency was introduced.
